IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senate Committee on Natural Resources, Ocean & Recreation (originally sponsored by Senators Jacobsen and Shin)

Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding unlawfully hunting on the property of another.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to unlawfully hunting while upon the property ofanother; and amending RCW 77.15.085.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 77.15.085 and 2000 c 107 s 232 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Fish and wildlife officers and ex officio fish and wildlifeofficers may seize without a warrant wildlife, fish, and shellfish theyhave probable cause to believe have been taken, transported, orpossessed in violation of this title ((or)), a rule of the commissionor director, or while committing the crime of criminal trespass in thesecond degree under RCW 9A.52.080.
